content.text: How many stores are in each city?

item.name: execute_sql_query
item.arguments:
{"query": "
SELECT
  `city`,
  COUNT(*) AS store_count
FROM `jdub_demo`.`lce_store_ops`.`stores`
GROUP BY `city`
ORDER BY store_count DESC, `city`
"}
